data.title: Anvil Hall Pulse
data.style: Industrial ambient-drone intro at 130 BPM with struck steel hits, anvil booms, dragged metal scrapes, and a deep mechanical rumble; verse-like opening stays bare and spacious, mid section adds longer ringing decays and sub pulses, final stretch thickens with layered clangs and a slow rising resonance. Huge stone-hall echo, stark, cold, and monumental., industrial, steady, deep, metal, industrial metal, slow
